title: I made this Endless Runner that is also a brain teaser
author: BeingComfortablyDumb
selftext:
Hey Guys! 

I made this Endless Runner game that has a cool twist that keeps your brain engaged constantly. It might just be annoying enough to make you play over and over! Please check it out and let me know what you think. 

This is my first project with Unreal using Codex and Claude via MCP. They helped me with the code, level design, game centre integrations and deployment. No external assets or GenAI was used in the game. All assets were built within the engine. A friend of mine gave me his older tracks to use as sound. 

This is the second game I've been able to finish all on my own. I really hope you guys like it 😅

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.mythicmotion.invertia

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/invertia/id6789579765

comments.author: That1guy4226
comments.body: the transition between lanes should probably be smoothed out a little bit. I would consider obscuring the bottoms of the building on the sides with something, perhaps with a fog, and making the dots underneath scroll slowly. Maybe it works maybe it doesnt. Idk. But this looks great over all. keep at it.

replies.author: BeingComfortablyDumb
replies.body:
Noted. Thank you for the feedback. 

I have a bunch of upgrades planned but I had to stop somewhere and deploy first or else I would've kept developing for another 6 months lol. 

Hopefully this is decent enough for a first version!

comments.author: FutureLynx_
comments.body: I like the visual clarity of it

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: the jump between lanes is cringe.. look at other endless runders they smowly go form lane to another..   The visual are tight  but got that lane jump makes me cry.. i play alot of endless runners. Even i its suppose to be the charater teleporting make an aniamtion effect

replies.author: BeingComfortablyDumb
replies.body:
That is already being fixed for the next update. The character is supposed to be phasing between lanes so I thought I could skip the side step. But that's about the only negative thing that bothered people so I'll fix it asap. 

Sorry it bothered you. I'd love to hear more since you play a lot of endless runners. Anything else you think I should fix? I'll be updating the entire visuals and animations for the next update.
